value.rationale: The natural complete bipartite simultaneous noisy voter model exhibits a structural stationary independence law counterintuitive given direct cross-part copying. Its two-population weak-noise disagreement of probability 1/2 and a universal critical scale 1/a+1/b yield a meaningful three-regime phase diagram and explicit non-Gaussian joint limit even with diverging part-size imbalance.
